# Nagdev Products Private Limited

> Integrated castor oil and chemical derivatives manufacturer situated in North Gujarat's prolific castor belt (Banaskantha–Vav-Tharad region). With an integrated 50 MT/day castor seed crushing capacity, continuous chemical refining, and downstream derivatives processing, Nagdev Products manufactures technical-grade castor oils, de-oiled cake organic fertilizers, hydrogenated castor wax (HCO), and 12-hydroxystearic acid (12-HSA). The manufacturing plant is currently under installation with commercial commissioning scheduled for 2027. Nagdev Products is actively booking forward 2027 industrial supply contracts and providing technical samples and specifications for domestic and international B2B buyers.

## Core Product Portfolio (Commissioning 2027)

1. [Commercial Grade Castor Oil](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/commercial-castor-oil): Standard industrial unrefined castor oil (CAS #8001-79-4, HS 1515.30) for lubricants, alkyd resins, and chemical synthesis.
2. [First Special Grade Castor Oil (FSG / BSS)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/first-special-grade-castor-oil): High-purity refined, bleached, and neutralized castor oil (CAS #8001-79-4, HS 1515.30) for urethanes, surfactants, and coatings.
3. [Castor Cake (Organic Manure)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/castor-cake): 100% natural expeller castor cake (HS 2306.90) containing 8–10% residual oil and 4.0–4.5% natural nitrogen, delivering slow nutrient release and soil conditioning for organic farming and plantations. Castor cake has traditionally been used by farmers as an organic soil amendment. Safety notice: Not for animal feed. Castor cake is toxic to livestock, poultry and pets if eaten. Store out of reach of animals and children. For agricultural soil application only.
4. [Hydrogenated Castor Oil (HCO / Castor Wax)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/hydrogenated-castor-oil): High melting point hard wax (CAS #8001-78-3, HS 1516.20) used for rheology modification, coatings, PVC lubricants, and cosmetics.
5. [Ricinoleic Acid (RA)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/ricinoleic-acid): Hydroxy fatty acid (CAS #141-22-0, HS 2918.19, 85%+ purity) for chemical synthesis, surfactants, cutting oils, and metalworking fluids.
6. [12-Hydroxystearic Acid (12-HSA)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/12-hydroxystearic-acid): Primary chemical building block (CAS #106-14-9, HS 2918.19) in flake/powder form for manufacturing lithium and complex lubricating greases.
7. [Refined Glycerin (USP / IP)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/refined-glycerin): 99.5% minimum purity technical and refined glycerin (CAS #56-81-5, HS 2905.45).

---

## Specialty Range (Available on Technical Enquiry)

8. [Cold Pressed Castor Oil](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/cold-pressed-castor-oil): Virgin single-press unrefined castor oil (CAS #8001-79-4, HS 1515.30) without chemical solvent extraction.
9. [Castor Oil BP 93 Grade (Pharma)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/castor-oil-bp93): Pharmacopoeia-grade analytical monograph castor oil (CAS #8001-79-4, HS 1515.30) compliant with BP 93 analytical specifications.
10. [Pale Pressed Grade Castor Oil (PPG)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/ppg-castor-oil): Premium low-acid, light-colored castor oil (CAS #8001-79-4, HS 1515.30) for cosmetics and specialty formulations.
11. [First Pressed Degummed Castor Oil (FPD)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/fpd-castor-oil): Virgin degummed hydraulic-pressed castor oil (CAS #8001-79-4, HS 1515.30) for industrial lubricants and chemical feedstocks.
12. [High Protein Castor Meal (N8 / N10)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/high-protein-castor-meal): Enriched castor protein meal (CAS #68187-58-6, HS 2306.90) delivering high nitrogen and organic matter for commercial farming.
13. [Crude Glycerin](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/crude-glycerin): Bio-based co-product (CAS #56-81-5, HS 1520.00, 80%+ glycerol content) from fatty acid splitting for industrial and chemical refining uses.
14. [Sodium Sulphate Anhydrous](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/sodium-sulphate-anhydrous): High-purity white crystalline co-product (CAS #7757-82-6, HS 2833.11) for detergents, glass manufacturing, and textile dyeing.
15. [Dehydrated Castor Oil (DCO)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/dehydrated-castor-oil): Conjugated drying oil (CAS #64147-40-6, HS 1518.00) for alkyd resins, printing inks, and protective varnishes.
16. [Dehydrated Castor Oil Fatty Acid (DCO-FA)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/dco-fatty-acid): High diene fatty acid (CAS #61789-45-5, HS 1518.00) for non-yellowing stoving enamels, epoxy esters, and polyamides.
17. [Blown / Oxidized Castor Oil](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/blown-oxidized-castor-oil): High-viscosity polymerized castor oil (CAS #68187-84-8, HS 1518.00) for plasticizers, lubricants, and hydraulic fluids.
18. [Bio-Polyurethane Polyols](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/bio-polyurethane-polyols): Renewable bio-based polyols derived from ricinoleic chemistry (HS code: available on request) for rigid and flexible foams, sealants, and CASE systems.
19. [Sebacic Acid](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/sebacic-acid): C10 dicarboxylic acid (CAS #111-20-6, HS 2917.13) for nylon 6,10, polyamides, bio-lubricants, and plasticizers.
20. [Methyl Ricinoleate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/methyl-ricinoleate): Low-viscosity ricinoleic methyl ester (CAS #141-24-2, HS code: available on request) for plasticizers, surfactant synthesis, and cutting fluids.
21. [Methyl 12-Hydroxystearate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/methyl-12-hydroxystearate): Ester derivative (CAS #141-23-1, HS code: available on request) for specialty greases, waxes, and cosmetics formulations.
22. [Dioctyl Sebacate (DOS / DEHS)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/dioctyl-sebacate): Low-temperature high-performance plasticizer (CAS #122-62-3 / 2432-87-3, HS 2917.13) for aerospace, PVC, and synthetic rubber.
23. [Dibutyl Sebacate (DBS)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/dibutyl-sebacate): High-efficiency plasticizer (CAS #109-43-3, HS 2917.13) for food-contact films, specialized coatings, and polymers.
24. [Lithium 12-Hydroxystearate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/lithium-12-hydroxystearate): Pre-reacted soap thickener (CAS #7620-77-1, HS code: available on request) for high-temperature multi-purpose NLGI automotive and industrial greases.
25. [Calcium 12-Hydroxystearate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/calcium-12-hydroxystearate): Non-toxic metallic soap (CAS #3159-62-4, HS code: available on request) for water-resistant lubricating greases and plastics processing.
26. [Zinc Ricinoleate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/zinc-ricinoleate): Highly effective natural odor-neutralizing salt (CAS #13040-19-2, HS code: available on request) for cosmetics, detergents, and industrial deodorization.
27. [Zinc Undecylenate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/zinc-undecylenate): Antifungal salt (CAS #557-08-4, HS 2916.19) for technical and personal care applications.

*Note on HS Tariff Classifications: Indicative classification; final HS code confirmed at the time of export.*

## Application Engineering Guides

- [Castor Oil in Industrial Lubricants](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/applications/castor-oil-for-lubricants): Tribological boundary lubrication, gearboxes, and extreme-pressure motor oils.
- [12-HSA for Lithium & Complex Greases](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/applications/12-hsa-for-lithium-grease): Fibrous soap crystallization, mechanical shear stability, and dropping points (>260°C).
- [HCO in Protective Coatings & PVC Lubrication](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/applications/hco-for-coatings-and-pvc): Thixotropic rheology in paints and internal/external lubrication in rigid PVC.
- [Castor Derivatives for Cosmetics](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/applications/castor-oil-for-cosmetics-and-personal-care): Refractive index gloss, pigment dispersion, and odor entrapment.
- [Bio-Polyurethane Polyols from Castor Oil](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/applications/castor-oil-for-polyurethane): Trifunctional natural polyols, moisture control (<0.05%), and CASE elastomers.
- [Castor Cake Organic Fertilizer](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/applications/castor-cake-organic-fertilizer): Organic NPK (4.5 : 1.5 : 1.5), nematicidal alkaloids (ricinine), and soil conditioning.

## Oleochemistry Technical Glossary

- [Hydroxyl Value (OHV)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/glossary/hydroxyl-value): AOCS Cd 13-60 / ASTM D1957 titration and stoichiometry.
- [Iodine Value (IV)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/glossary/iodine-value): Wijs method (ISO 3961) tracking double-bond hydrogenation.
- [Acid Value (AV) & FFA](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/glossary/acid-value): AOCS Cd 3d-63 measurement of unesterified fatty acids.
- [Saponification Value](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/glossary/saponification-value): Mean molecular weight determination and soap stoichiometry.
- [Ricinoleic Acid](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/glossary/ricinoleic-acid): 12-hydroxy-cis-9-octadecenoic acid molecular structure.
- [Gardner & Lovibond Colour](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/glossary/gardner-colour): Optical clarity and color refinement standards.
- [Catalytic Hydrogenation](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/glossary/hydrogenation): Autoclave pressure synthesis of Castor Wax.
- [Moisture & Impurities (M&I)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/glossary/castor-oil-moisture-and-impurities): Karl Fischer coulometric testing down to ppm levels.
